title: Venomoth's Dust Color Decides How You Lose
premise: Venomoth's wing powder has two different effects, and its color tells you which one you face.
audiencePromise: Show how Venomoth's scales signal two different dangers before the powder reaches you.
openLoop: What exactly changes when Venomoth's wing powder changes color?
payoff: Venomoth's wings turn one attack into two outcomes: poison you or stop you standing.
engagementQuestion: Which loss feels worse to you: poison or paralysis?

voice.instructions: Use a tense, curious pace. Stress color, dark, light, poison, and paralysis. Pause briefly before each contrast.

scenes.headline: COLOR DECIDES YOUR LOSS
scenes.narration: One color poisons. The other stops you standing.
scenes.caption: THE COLOR IS A WARNING

scenes.headline: COLOR-CODED SCALES
scenes.narration: Its wing scales are color-coded to show which poison it carries.
scenes.caption: THE SCALES SIGNAL THE DANGER

scenes.headline: THE POWDER STICKS
scenes.narration: Hard-to-remove scales leak poison when they touch your skin.
scenes.caption: CONTACT IS ENOUGH

scenes.headline: THE DUST GOES EVERYWHERE
scenes.narration: Then Venomoth flaps violently, scattering poisonous powder all around.
scenes.caption: ONE FLAP WIDENS THE DANGER

scenes.headline: LIGHT ISN'T SAFER
scenes.narration: Light powder sounds better, until paralysis leaves you unable to stand.
scenes.caption: DIFFERENT EFFECT. SAME THREAT.

scenes.headline: WHICH EFFECT IS WORSE?
scenes.narration: Which loss feels worse to you: poison or paralysis?
scenes.caption: POISON OR PARALYSIS?
